steps.title: Pip finds Rory!
steps.voice: Pip found Rory the Raptor. Rory wants to make a dinosaur picnic!

steps.title: Back to Wonder Island
steps.voice: Let's bring the dinosaur egg home to Wonder Island!

steps.title: The Rainbow Is Missing!
steps.voice: Octo needs help putting the rainbow colours back.

steps.title: The Rainbow Is Back!
steps.voice: Every colour is shining again!

steps.title: Paint Party!
steps.voice: Octo is making a colourful party banner.

steps.title: Party Ready!
steps.voice: The banner looks wonderful!

steps.title: Shape House Rescue!
steps.voice: The shape house pieces have fallen apart.

steps.title: House Fixed!
steps.voice: Every shape is back where it belongs.

steps.title: Balloon Mix-Up!
steps.voice: The parade balloons are all mixed up.

steps.title: Balloons Ready!
steps.voice: The balloons are sorted and ready to go.

steps.title: Build the Parade Float!
steps.voice: Octo needs help getting the parade ready.

steps.title: Parade Time!
steps.voice: The float is ready. Let the parade begin!

steps.title: Nest Number Hunt
steps.voice: Rory found nests with number stones.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The nests are ready, and a Baby Triceratops came to visit!

steps.title: Hungry Herd
steps.voice: The dinosaur herd is hungry for picnic treats.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Everyone has enough food now!

steps.title: More or Less Trail
steps.voice: Footprints lead across Dino Valley.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You followed every clue on the trail!

steps.title: Same Nest Rescue
steps.voice: The eggs need matching nests with the same amount.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Every egg is safe in the right nest!

steps.title: Dino Bedtime
steps.voice: The sleepy dinosaurs need the right-sized beds.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The whole valley is tucked in!

steps.title: Fossil Number Trail
steps.voice: Rory found shiny fossils and number stones.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The fossil trail is complete!

steps.title: Dino Train Parade
steps.voice: The dinosaur train needs everything in the right order.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The Dino Train is ready to roll!

steps.title: Plus-One Picnic
steps.voice: More dinosaur friends keep joining the picnic.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You made room for every new friend!

steps.title: Ten Egg Rescue
steps.voice: Ten eggs are scattered near the nesting ground.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: All ten eggs are back together!

steps.title: Who Lives Here?
steps.voice: Bella heard new friends in the forest.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Every animal found its kind of home!

steps.title: Baby Animal Rescue
steps.voice: Some baby animals are looking for their grown-ups.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Every baby is back with its family!

steps.title: Forest Breakfast
steps.voice: Breakfast time has arrived in Animal Forest.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You helped serve a forest breakfast!

steps.title: Feather, Fur & Scales
steps.voice: Look closely at feathers, fur and scales.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You spotted all the different body coverings!

steps.title: Pond Parade
steps.voice: The pond friends are making a noisy parade.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The Pond Parade is ready!

steps.title: Luna’s Letter Garden
steps.voice: Luna found letters growing like flowers.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The Letter Garden is blooming!

steps.title: Big & Little Letters
steps.voice: Some big and little letters lost their partners.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The letter partners are together again!

steps.title: First Sound Picnic
steps.voice: Luna packed a picnic full of word sounds.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You listened for the first sounds!

steps.title: My Name Letter
steps.voice: There is a special letter at the start of your name.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You found a letter from your own name!

steps.title: Luna’s Word Hunt
steps.voice: Luna is collecting useful new words.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Your story word collection grew!

steps.title: Bella Gets Ready
steps.voice: Bella is getting ready for a fun day.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Bella is ready to play!

steps.title: Rainy Day Dress-Up
steps.voice: The weather keeps changing outside.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You picked clothes that fit the weather!

steps.title: Toy Tidy Party
steps.voice: The playroom had a very busy day.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Everything has a useful place!

steps.title: Feelings Picnic
steps.voice: Bella and her friends have lots of different feelings.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You found kind ways to handle big feelings!

steps.title: Helping Hands
steps.voice: There are little ways to help everywhere.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Helping together made the day easier!

steps.title: Build the Rocket
steps.voice: The rocket is in pieces. Let’s build it and blast off!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Blast off! You built a rocket!

steps.title: Build a Robot Helper
steps.voice: Pip wants a robot helper. Let’s build one!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Beep boop! The robot says thank you!

steps.title: Count the Stars
steps.voice: The planetarium is full of stars and planets!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You counted the whole sky!

steps.title: The Shape Lab
steps.voice: The shapes fell out of the shape lab machine!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The shape lab is working again!

steps.title: Control Panel Lights
steps.voice: The control panel lights need fixing.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: All the lights are shining!

steps.title: Moon Rock Samples
steps.voice: Pip found jars from the Moon. Let’s look!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a great space scientist!

steps.title: Lunch in Space
steps.voice: Space walks make Pip hungry!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Yum! Pip is full and happy.

steps.title: Tidy the Space Base
steps.voice: The space base is messy. Let’s tidy up!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The space base is spick and span!

steps.title: Who Helps?
steps.voice: Busy Town has lots of helpers. Who helps who?

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You know all the town helpers!

steps.title: Traffic Lights
steps.voice: Red means stop. Green means go!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Stop, look and listen. Well done!

steps.title: Park the Cars
steps.voice: The garage is full of cars. Let’s park them!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Every car is parked!

steps.title: Shopping Day
steps.voice: Pip has a shopping list!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The shopping is done. Yum!

steps.title: Deliver the Parcels
steps.voice: The mail van is here with deliveries!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Everything is delivered!

steps.title: Bus Stop
steps.voice: All aboard! Let’s ride the bus.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a fun ride!

steps.title: Town Hospital
steps.voice: Doctors and nurses help us feel better.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You are a kind helper!

steps.title: Building Site
steps.voice: The builders are building a new toy shop!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The new toy shop is finished!

steps.title: Vehicle Parade
steps.voice: Here comes the vehicle parade! Let’s help every vehicle find its way.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a wonderful parade!

steps.title: Big Helpers
steps.voice: Big vehicles do big jobs. Let’s help them!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Thank you, big helpers!

steps.title: Sweet Shape Shop
steps.voice: Octo opened a sweet shop full of shapes. Let’s help!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a sweet shop! Every shape is in the right place.

steps.title: Octo’s Sea Friends
steps.voice: Octo found a sea egg in the rainbow pond! Let’s help the sea friends.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The sea egg is ready to hatch on Wonder Island!

steps.title: Colour Splash Day
steps.voice: It is Colour Splash Day in Rainbow Village!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Rainbow Village is full of colour again!

steps.title: Farm Morning
steps.voice: Bella found an egg in the hay! Let’s help on the farm.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The farm egg will hatch on Wonder Island!

steps.title: Muddy Piglet
steps.voice: Oh no! Piglet rolled in the mud.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Piglet is clean and happy!

steps.title: Moo Moo Parade
steps.voice: The farm animals are having a parade!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a moo-velous parade!

steps.title: A is for Apple
steps.voice: Luna found a stone with a letter on it!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: A is for apple! Luna loves your reading.

steps.title: Luna’s Moon Story
steps.voice: Luna is reading a bedtime story about the moon.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Goodnight, moon! What a lovely story.

steps.title: Word Builders
steps.voice: Luna needs help building her word book.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Luna’s word book is full!

steps.title: How Do I Feel?
steps.voice: Everyone has big feelings. Let’s help Bella name them.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You know so many feelings!

steps.title: Bedtime for Bella
steps.voice: It is nearly bedtime for Bella.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Goodnight, Bella. Sweet dreams!

steps.title: Tidy-Up Helpers
steps.voice: The playroom is messy. Let’s tidy up together!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The playroom is tidy. Great helping!

steps.title: Hello, Jungle!
steps.voice: Listen! The jungle is full of music.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: You found the jungle music!

steps.title: Animal Band
steps.voice: The jungle animals want to start a band!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The animal band is ready to play!

steps.title: Big and Small Beats
steps.voice: Big drums go BOOM. Little bells go ting!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Big and small, loud and quiet. Well done!

steps.title: Lion Cub’s Lullaby
steps.voice: A little lion cub is sleepy. Let’s sing a quiet song.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The lion cub’s egg is ready to hatch on Wonder Island!

steps.title: Flamingo Dance
steps.voice: The flamingos are dancing on one leg!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a beautiful flamingo dance!

steps.title: Build the Stage
steps.voice: The band needs a stage. Let’s build it!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: The jungle stage is ready!

steps.title: Sloth Slows Down
steps.voice: Sloth likes to take things nice and slow.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Slow and steady. Sloth is so proud of you!

steps.title: Grand Jungle Concert
steps.voice: Tonight is the Grand Jungle Concert!

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: What a concert! The whole jungle is dancing.

steps.title: Rory’s Nest Check
steps.voice: Rory is checking on all the dino nests.

steps.title: Great work!
steps.voice: Every nest is safe. Thank you!
